title: RectangleShape2D.extents renamed to size but numbers stay half-extents

blocks.text:
RectangleShape2D no longer has a property called extents, but rather size.
Instead of the half-width/height, it stores the full width and height. The
built-in 3-to-4 converter correctly renames extents to size in scene files,
but it keeps the numbers the same, which results in every single
RectangleShape2D being half the intended size. Circles seem unaffected.
This compiles and runs with no error — collision bodies are just silently
half as large. Searching tscn files for type="RectangleShape2D" is faster
than opening scenes one by one.
